spans.s:
पृशन पृशन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. rt. स्पृश्), Ved.
clinging to, attached to; tender, gentle (only used in
the fem.); (अम्), n. clinging to.

पृशनायु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. clinging to, attached
to; tender; (Sāy.) = स्पर्शन-काम, desirous of
contact.

पृश्नि पृश्नि, इस्, इस्, इ (said to be fr. rt.
स्पृश्, the initial स् being elided, see Uṇādi-s.
IV. 52

),
variegated, party-coloured, dappled, piebald, speckled,
spotted (used in the Veda as a favourite epithet of
cows); manifold, diverse, various, of many kinds
(Ved.); dwarfish, stunted, short, thin, small; deli-
cate, feeble; (इस्), f. (like all other words for ‘cow’
used in various figurative or mythical senses, viz.)
earth, a cloud, milk, the spangled or starry sky, a
ray of light; a kind of fruit; N. of the mother of
the Maruts; of the wife of Savitṛ; of the wife of
king Su-tapas (who in a former birth under the name
of Devakī was mother of Kṛṣṇa); (ई), f. the plant
Pistia Stratiotes; (इस्), m. a dwarf; N. of a prince
the father of Śvaphalka; (अयस्), m. pl., N. of a
race of Ṛṣis; पृश्नि or भरद्वाजस्य पृश्नि,
N. of a Sāman; [cf. rts. पृष् and स्पृश्; पृष्-
अत, पृषत्, पृषटी: Gr. περκ-νό-ς, πέρκο-ς,
περκαίνειν, πρακ-νό-ν, πρεκ-νό-ν, πρόξ, προκά-ς,
πρώξ, πρόκ-νη: Lat. spurc-u-s, sparg-o: Old
Germ. spreng-en: Mod. Germ. be-spreng-en = Eng.
sprinkle.]
—पृश्नि-गर्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, being in
the variegated bosom or in the bosom of the varie-
gated one (Sāy. = आदित्यस्य गर्भ-भूत or
[]
सप्तोज्ज्वल-वर्णाः सूर्य-रश्मयस् तेषां गर्-
भ-भूत); (अस्), m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
—पृश्नि-गु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. driving piebald horses
(said of the Maruts; Sāy. = पृश्नि-वर्णा अश्वा
येषां ते); (उस्), m., N. of a man.
—पृश्नि-त्व,
अम्, n., Ved. the being variegated or party-coloured,
the being speckled or spotted.
—पृश्नि-धर, अस्,
m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
—पृश्नि-निप्रेषित, अस्,
आ, अम्, Ved. sent down or hastening down to Pṛśni,
i. e. to the earth (said of the Maruts); (Sāy.) =
पृश्न्या मात्रा नितराम् प्रयताः, sent down
by their mother Pṛśni.
—पृश्नि-पर्णी, f. ‘having
variegated leaves,’ N. of a plant, Hemionitis Cordi-
folia.
—पृश्नि-बाहु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. having speckled
arms, i. e. front legs (said of a frog); (उस्), m., N.
of a mythical being.
—पृश्नि-भद्र, अस्, m. ‘pro-
pitious to Devakī,’ an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
—पृश्नि-
मत् or पृश्नि-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. containing
the word पृश्नि.
—पृश्नि-मातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved.
‘having Pṛśni for a mother,’ an epithet of the
Maruts; ‘having the earth for a mother,’ an epithet
of herbs.
—पृश्नि-शृङ्ग, अस्, m. ‘having a small
or a variegated crest,’ an epithet of Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu
incarnate as Kṛṣṇa; of Gaṇeśa.
—पृश्नि-सक्थ,
अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having spotted thighs.
—पृश्नि-
हन्, आ, m., Ved. slaying the speckled (snake).
—पृश्न्य्-आह्वया, f. = पृश्नि-पर्णी, q. v.
पृश्निका, f. an aquatic plant, Pistia Stratiotes.

पृष् पृष् (akin to rt. प्रुष्; cf. rts.
स्पृश् and वृष्), cl. 1. P. पर्षति, प-
पर्ष, पर्षिष्यति, अपर्षीत्, पर्षितुम्, to
sprinkle; to weary; to vex; to hurt, injure; to give;
cl. 1. A. पर्षते, पर्षितुम् (a various reading
for rt. वृष्), to become wet: Caus. पर्षयति,
यितुम्, Aor. अपपर्षत्, अपीपृशत्: Desid. पि-
पर्षिषति: Intens. परीपृश्यते, परीपर्ष्टि:
[cf. पृश्नि; Zend परेष्, ‘to sprinkle.’]

पृषत्, अन्, अती, अत्, (Ved.) spotted, speckled,
mottled, dappled, piebald, party-coloured, variegated;
sprinkling (in this sense used as a part.); (अन्),
m. the spotted antelope; the hog deer, porcine
deer; पृषताम् पतिः, ‘lord of the spotted ante-
lopes,’ a N. of the Wind; (अती), f. a spotted cow;
epithet of the animals ridden by the Maruts (usually
said by commentators to be spotted antelopes, ac-
cording to Mahī-dhara piebald mares, and often
apparently identified in the Ṛg-veda with the horses
of the Maruts); the female spotted antelope, spotted
doe; = पार्षती, the daughter of Pṛṣata; (अत्), n. a
drop of water or of any other liquid.
—पृषत्-ता, f. or
पृषत्-त्व, अम्, n. the being spotted or variegated.
—पृषद्-अश्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. ‘having piebald
horses,’ an epithet of the Maruts; (according to Sāy.)
riding on spotted antelopes; (अस्), m. air, wind, the
god of air or wind divinely personified; an epithet
of Śiva; N. of a man; of a son of An-araṇya and
father of Hary-aśva; of a son of Vi-rūpa; (आस्), m.
pl., N. of the descendants of Pṛṣad-aśva.
—पृषद्-
आज्य, अम्, n. sprinkled or clotted butter, ghee mixed
with coagulated milk forming an oblation.
—पृषद्-
आज्य-प्रणुत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. driven away from
the oblation of ghee and curds.
—पृषद्-वत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, Ved. party-coloured, variegated.
—पृषद्-
वत्स, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a spotted calf.
—पृ-
षद्-वरा, f. ‘the best among the variegated ante-
lopes,’ N. of a wife of Ruru and daughter of a Vidhyā-
dhara by Menakā (a sort of antelope).
—पृषद्-
वल, अस्, m. ‘piebald,’ N. of a horse of Vāyu or
Wind; [cf. पृषद्-अश्व.]
—पृषद्-वाण, अस्,
m. ‘having variegated arrows,’ N. of a man.
—पृ-
षोदर, अस्, आ, अम् (पृष for पृषत् + उदर),
Ved. ‘speckled-bellied,’ having the belly speckled,
(see Scholiast on Pāṇ.

पृषत, अस्, आ, अम्, spotted, speckled, having
white spots, variegated; (अस्), m. the spotted ante-
lope, the porcine deer; a drop of water; a spot,
mark; N. of the father of Dru-pada.
—पृषताश्व
(˚त-अश्˚), अस्, m. air, wind (= पृषद्-अश्व).

पृषत्क, अस्, m. an arrow (so called as being
variegated or as being as swift as an antelope).

पृषद्धर or पृषध्र, अस्, m. (probably a
comp. fr. पृषत् + ध्र), N. of a man the son
of Manu and author of the hymn Ṛg-veda

VIII.
57
(= Vālakhilya 8).

पृषध्रु, उस्, m., N. of a warrior on the side
of the Pāṇḍavas.

पृषन्ति, इस्, m. a drop of water (probably an
error for पृषन्ति, n. pl. of पृषत्).

पृषातक, अम्, n. a mixture of ghee and coagu-
lated milk or some similar compound; (अस्), m. an
epithet of Rudra; (ई), f. a kind of disease or N. of
a female demon causing this disease.

पृषोद्यान, अम्, n. (fr. पृष for पृषत् +
उद्यान), a small garden or grove.

1. पृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. and 3. see below),
sprinkled.

पृष्ट 2. पृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (for स्पृष्ट fr. rt.
स्पृश्), Ved. cleaving or adhering to, in contact
with (Sāy. = सं-स्पृष्ट, or = नि-षिक्त = नि-
हित).
—पृष्ट-बन्धु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. (perhaps)
having devoted relatives or attendants; (Sāy.) = स्तो-
तॄणाम् बन्धुः, a friend to those who praise him.

पृष्ट 3. पृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. प्रछ्),
asked, inquired, questioned, interrogated, demanded.
—पृष्टाभिधायिन् (˚ट-अभ्˚), ई, इनी, इ, Ved. an-
swering that which is asked, answering an inquiry.

पृषभाषा पृष-भाषा, f. = पूष-भासा,
q. v.

पृषाकरा पृषाकरा, f. a small stone used
as a weight.

पृष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. a rib (= पर्शु); touch; a
ray of light.
—पृष्टि-वह्, वाट्, m., Ved. carrying
on the back (as a horse).
—पृष्ट्य्-आमय, अस्,
m., Ved. a pain in the side.
—पृष्ट्य्-आमयिन्, ई,
इनी, इ, Ved. feeling a pain in the side.

पृष्ट्वा, ind. having asked or inquired, having
questioned or interrogated.

पृष्टहायन पृष्टहायन, अस्, m. an ele-
phant; a species of grain.

पृष्ठ पृष्ठ, अम्, n. (probably fr. प्र-स्थ
or perhaps fr. परा-स्थ), the back of any animal
(as standing out prominently), the back in general
(e. g. अश्व-पृष्ठे सम्मतः, admired on horse-
back, i. e. a good rider; पृष्ठं दा, to bend
the back, make a low obeisance); the hinder part
of anything, the rear [cf. सेना-प्˚]; the upper side,
uppermost part, surface, superficies (e. g. दिवः
पृष्ठम्, Ved. the surface of the sky, vault of
heaven; cf. घृत-प्˚, तृ-प्˚, नाक-प्˚); the flat
roof of a house; a terrace; a page of a book; N.
of a particular arrangement of Sāmans employed at
the midday oblation, and formed from the Rathan-
tara, Bṛhat, Vairūpa, Vairāja, Śākvara, and Raivata
Sāmans, (in this sense more usually written as a
comp. पृष्ठ-स्तोत्र, q. v.); N. of various Sā-
mans; (एन, ए), ind. at the back, behind, from
behind.
—पृष्ठ-गोप, अस्, m. one who guards
or protects the rear of a warrior while fighting.
—पृष्ठ-ग्रन्थि, इस्, m. ‘back-knot,’ a hump
on the back.
—पृष्ठ-घ्न, अस्, m., N. of a
man.
—पृष्ठ-चक्षुस्, उस्, m. ‘having eyes in
the back,’ a crab.
—पृष्ठ-ज, अस्, m. a form of
Skanda; (also considered as a son of Skanda.)
—पृष्ठ-जाह, अम्, n. = पृष्ठस्य मूलम्,
‘the root of the back,’ (probably) os coccygis; [cf.
जाह.]
—पृष्ठ-तल्पन, अम्, n. the exterior
muscles on an elephant's back (= तल्पन).
—पृष्-
ठ-दृष्टि, इस्, m. ‘looking backwards,’ a bear.
—पृष्ठ-पातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, being behind the
back of a person, following, observing, controlling.
—पृष्ठ-फल, अम्, n. the superficial contents
of a figure.
—पृष्ठ-भङ्ग, अस्, m. ‘breaking
or bending the back,’ epithet of a mode of fighting.
—पृष्ठ-भाग, अस्, m. the hinder part, back.
—पृष्ठ-मध्य, अस्, m. the middle of the
back.
—पृष्ठ-मांस, अम्, n. the flesh on the
back; पृष्ठमांसं खाद् or भक्ष्, ‘to eat
[]
the flesh of a person's back,’ i. e. to speak ill of any
one behind his back.
—पृष्ठमांसाद (˚स-
अद˚) or पृष्ठमांसादन (˚स-अद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
‘eating the flesh of the back,’ backbiting, speaking
ill of a person behind his back, a backbiter, tale-
bearer, slanderer; (अम्), n. backbiting.
—पृष्ठ-
यज्वन्, आ, m., Ved. one who sacrifices on high
places (Sāy. = रथन्तर-बृहद्-आदिभिर् ईजान).
—पृष्ठ-यान, अम्, n. ‘going on the back (of
a horse &c.), riding; (अस्, आ, अम्), an animal for
riding, riding horse.
—पृष्ठ-रक्ष, अस्, m. one
who covers the rear of a warrior while fighting;
[cf. पृष्ठ-गोप.]
—पृष्ठ-रक्षण, अम्,
n. protection or defence of the back.
—पृष्ठ-
वंश, अस्, m. the back-bone.
—पृष्ठ-वास्तु, उ,
n. an upper story, the upper room of a building.
—पृष्ठ-वाह्, ट्, m. (f. पृष्ठौही, see

Gram.
182

. c), a draught-ox, an ox employed for draught,
(also read प्रष्ठ-वाह् and पष्ठ-वाह्); ‘borne
on the back,’ riding.
—पृष्ठ-वाह्य, अस्, m. a
draught-ox, an ox carrying burdens.
—पृष्ठ-
शय, अस्, आ, अम्, lying or sleeping on the back.
—पृष्ठ-शृङ्ग, अस्, m. ‘having horns over the
back,’ a wild goat.
—पृष्ठ-शृङ्गिन्, ई, m. a
ram; a buffalo; a eunuch; an epithet of Bhīma-sena.
—पृष्ठ-स्तोत्र, अम्, n., N. of a particular
arrangement of Sāmans (= पृष्ठ, q. v.).
—पृष्-
ठानुग (˚ठ-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, or पृष्ठानु-
गामिन् (˚ठ-अन्˚), ई, इनी, इ, going behind, following
(opposed to अग्र-ग).
—पृष्ठास्थि (˚ठ-अस्˚),
इ, n. the back-bone.
—पृष्ठे-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्,
having the face in the back.
—पृष्ठोदय (˚ठ-
उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘rising from behind,’ an epithet of
the signs of the zodiac, Aries, Taurus, Gemini,
Sagittarius, and Capricorn.

पृष्ठक, अम्, n. the back; पृष्ठके कृ,
to place behind, postpone; to resign, renounce.

पृष्ठ-तस्, ind. from the back, from behind,
behind the back, at the back, behind (with gen.);
to the back, backwards; on the back; behind the
back, secretly, covertly; पृष्ठतः कृ, to place
on the back (e. g. पर्वतम् पृष्ठतः कृत्वा,
having placed the mountain on his back); to place
behind the back, neglect, forsake, abandon; to re-
sign, renounce, desist from; पृष्ठतो गम्, to go
at the back, follow, pursue; पृष्ठतो भू, to be
behind, i. e. to be disregarded, to be an object of
indifference.

पृष्ठ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, relating or belonging to
the back; belonging to or coming from the heights
(Ved., e. g. पृष्ठ्यम् पयः, ‘milk from the
heights,’ i. e. Soma, or according to Sāy. = धार-
कम् पयः, sustaining milk); forming the Pṛṣṭha
hymns (Ved.); having the Pṛṣṭha hymns (said of
a particular period of six sacrificial days, Ved.); (अस्),
m. with or without अश्व, a horse for riding or for
draught, a pack-horse; (अस्, अम्), m. n. = पृष्ठा-
नां समूहः [cf. Pāṇ.

] = स्तोत्राणां
समूहः (Ujjvala-datta on Uṇādi-s.
II. 12

); (आ),
f. with or without अश्वा, a mare for riding or for
draught; an edge or ridge along the back of the
Vedi (Ved.).
—पृष्ठ्य-स्तोम, अस्, m., Ved., N.
of six Ekāhas or of a period of six sacrificial days.
—पृष्ठ्यावलम्ब (˚य-अव्˚), अस्, m., Ved.,
scil. पञ्चाह, a period of five sacrificial days.

पृष्णि पृष्णि, इस्, इस्, इ, small, short, or thin
(= पृश्नि); (इस्), f. the heel (= पार्ष्णि); a ray of
light (= पृश्नि).

पृष्णिपर्णी पृष्णि-पर्णी, f. a wrong read-
ing for पृश्नि-पर्णी, q. v.
पृष्वा पृष्वा, incorrectly for प्रुष्वा, q. v.
